_A Working Journal_

Not every concept begins as a finished piece. This page holds the raw fragments, structural references, and field notes that shape a form before it is realized.

  

### NOTE 01: THE MONOLITHIC INFLUENCE

The uncompromising geometry of Brutalist structures along the Danube does not contradict our sculptural practice in London — it anchors it. The raw silhouettes of Ruse were the first visual discipline I absorbed, long before approaching them as architectural reference.

  

NOTE 02: GENERATIVE ROOTS

Before generating the first prompt sequence for the studio, the inquiry was physical rather than algorithmic: how does structural tension exist within an object designed to be carried? The generative iterations were disciplined attempts to resolve that weight.

  

NOTE 03: ON SCALE & DISCIPLINE

SILVER & ELEGANT approaches jewellery as micro-architecture, scaling monumental volumes down to the human body. The trajectory crosses Bulgaria, Türkiye, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom.

Along this path, software development discipline merged directly with Kapalıçarşı’s singular metalwork tradition. Not as an abstraction, but as a deliberate daily practice.

  

FOOTER NOTE

This working archive expands with each body of work. It remains an unadorned record of process, form, and material logic.
